fee_notes: Continuing Fee (royalty) is tiered: 4% of Gross Sales for weeks 1-52, then 5% of Gross Sales (or $100/week minimum, whichever is greater) from week 53 onward. Advertising Fee is 2%-2.5% of Gross Sales; franchisees who joined before January 31, 2018 pay 1.5% (up to 2% at Smartstyle's discretion). Fees paid weekly by direct bank transfer. Additional fees include: Tax Reimbursement, Audit Cost Reimbursement, Annual Convention (up to $1,000/person), Transfer Fee ($2,500-$7,500+ depending on number of salons), Sublease Payments ($1,000-$5,600/month), Lease Renewal Fee ($1,500), Interest/Late Fees (1.5%/month or max allowed + $100 admin fee), Electronic Communications Fee (up to $500/year), Modernization (~$50,000 per 10-year cycle), Gift Card ACH Settlement ($10/month per bank account), Alternate Supplier Review (actual expenses).
raw_excerpt:
Continuing Fees(2) Weeks 1 through 52: 4% of Gross Sales(3) Week 53 through end of Franchise Agreement Term: 5% of Gross Sales or $100 per week, whichever is greater
Advertising Fees(4) 2%-2.5% of Gross Sales
Tax Reimbursement Reimbursement of Smartstyle's tax payments
Reimbursement of Audit Costs The unpaid amounts due, plus our administrative fee and interest from the date originally due until the date of payment.
Annual Conventions(5) Up to $1,000 per person attending
Transfer Fee 1 salon $2,500 / 2 salons $4,500 / 3 salons $6,000 / 4 salons $7,000 / 5 salons $7,500 / Each salon after is $500
Sublease payments (6) Amount due under lease which ranges from $1,000 - $5,600.
Lease Renewal Fee (7) $1,500
Interest Charges & Late Fees 1.5% per month or the highest commercial contract interest rate the law allows, whichever is less. In addition, you must pay us a One-Hundred Dollar ($100) administrative fee. $100 late fee for failure to submit weekly sales reports on time.
Electronic Communications Fee (8) Up to $500 per year
Modernization (9) $50,000 adjusted for inflation for capital improvements to modernize and update Salon location or as required by Walmart
Gift Card Transactions ACH Monthly Settlement Service Fees of $10/month per Bank Account
Alternate Supplier Review Amount not to exceed actual expenses of review
